title: Mirror Fairy in Ruins
description: A full-body female figure covered in silver mirror disco tiles stands centered, one arm raised. She has large iridescent fairy wings, a crown of red poppies, yellow daisies and purple flowers with green ferns, and wears flowing teal and white fabric with ivy vines. Disco balls float around her against a dark cosmic background with stone ruins, mossy stairs, and a framed painting of an enchanted forest.
